title: Chuy’s Chicka-Chicka Boom-Boom Enchiladas

ingredientGroups.title: Ingredients
items: 1¼ lb roasted chicken, seasoned with garlic, salt and pepper

steps: Fill each tortilla with 2 oz cooked roasted chicken, roll and place in a baking pan.
Top with mixed jack cheese. Warm in a hot oven for 4 minutes, until the cheese melts.
